name: Vireo Grid
tagline: The personal charging grid for everything that moves you.
positioning: Vireo Grid turns your garage, balcony, and city into one intelligent charging layer for the e-bikes, scooters, and small EVs you actually ride.

hero.h1: Charge your whole fleet-of-one on a single living grid.
hero.sub: Vireo Grid unifies your e-bike, scooter, and cargo trike into one adaptive charging network — balancing power, tracking every watt, and topping off overnight so you roll out at 100% every morning.

features.title: Adaptive Load Balancing
features.description: Vireo watches your home circuit in real time and feathers power across every dock, so three vehicles charge at once without ever tripping a breaker.

features.title: Watt-Level Insight
features.description: See cost, range added, and battery health for each ride down to the cell. Export a monthly energy ledger your accountant will actually respect.

features.title: Sunrise Scheduling
features.description: Set a departure time and Vireo backfills charge during the cheapest off-peak hours, finishing minutes before you touch the throttle.

features.title: Battery Guardian
features.description: Thermal and chemistry-aware limits keep every pack in its sweet spot, extending lifespan and quietly refusing to overcharge.

features.title: City Roaming
features.description: Your grid follows you. Unlock Vireo public docks across town and every kilowatt lands on the same invoice.

features.title: Over-the-Air Everything
features.description: Docks gain new vehicle profiles and safety logic overnight — no service call, no dongle, no drama.

testimonials.quote: I run four delivery e-bikes off one garage outlet. Before Vireo I was rotating chargers like a maniac; now they all wake up full and I have a receipt for every watt.
testimonials.name: Dane Okafor

testimonials.quote: Sunrise scheduling alone paid for the hardware. My scooter charges at 2am rates and I still leave at 100% by seven every morning.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkatesh

testimonials.quote: As a fleet-of-one with two e-bikes and a moped, I finally have battery data I trust. Guardian flagged a swelling cell before it became a fire.
testimonials.name: Tomas Reinholt

For the multi-vehicle household or busy fleet-of-one.
For buildings, co-ops, and micro-fleet operators.

homepage.footerBlurb: Vireo Grid is building the personal energy layer for micro-mobility — one living grid for every small electric thing you own, from balcony to boulevard.
